pub fn classify_block(input: &[u8; BLOCK_BYTES], carry: &mut ScanCarry) -> Result<BlockMasks>
unsafe_justifications: The private AVX2 helper is compiled only for x86 or x86_64 and is called only after the root is_supported function establishes CPU and OS support or statically enabled AVX2 for no-std builds.
The two unaligned 32-byte loads read exactly offsets 0 through 31 and 32 through 63 of a borrowed 64-byte array. Pointer addition remains inside that array, and no vector alignment is required.
Movemask results are converted from i32 through u32 before widening to u64, preventing the lower lane sign bit from contaminating upper lane bits.
Partial slices reach SIMD only through tails::load_block bounded storage. All fallible processing uses staged carry, and the caller's carry is committed only after RawMasks::finish succeeds.
test_vectors: Canonical ClassifyFn assignment and exact bracket masks.
Empty input with all four canonical quote carry combinations and opaque UTF-8 fields.
All 256 byte values repeated across full blocks, plus four sequential 64-byte ranges, compared with an independent bytewise oracle.
Isolated quotes and backslashes at every position, with explicit positions 31, 32, and 63 for signed movemask regression coverage.
128 deterministically generated full blocks spanning arbitrary bytes and a JSON-focused alphabet, compared with scalar and independent oracles.
Every length from 0 through 64 across mixed, zero, backslash, and quote blocks with all canonical incoming quote states; every ABI mask is checked for padding leakage.
Full-array and slice entry point equivalence, deliberately unaligned full blocks, and bounded subslices surrounded by quote sentinels.
Exact raw punctuation and escaped quote masks inside a string, while structural punctuation excludes string content.
Backslash runs of lengths 0 through 64 crossing block boundaries and selected runs crossing the 32-byte lane boundary.
Every split point from 0 through 64 across mixed, backslash, and quote blocks reproduces continuous byte masks and final carry.
Unclosed strings, invalid escapes, control bytes, malformed JSON, and invalid UTF-8 remain classifiable; exact ASCII whitespace, control, digit, and non-ASCII masks.
Oversized lengths 65, 66, 127, 128, 255, 256, and 1024 return InvalidToken with Scanner source and offset zero, preserving carry.
Noncanonical quote fields 2, 3, 2^32, and u64::MAX return InternalError for empty, partial, and full blocks without changing carry.
